emma (content): Morning — quick async standup. What I did: finished the benchmark blog draft, uploaded images, queued the open graph. Blockers: need Liam to sanity-check the throughput numbers; a few figures might be off after yesterday's run. Today: iterate on feedback, final review, schedule for Fri 08:00 PT.

liam (benchmarks): On it. Re-ran bench overnight with the quantized profile, numbers changed — I'll post summary in thread. Blocker: noticed one config regressed (batching). @emma can you confirm the sequence length assumption? I'll attach logs.

liam (benchmarks): Gist: 3 endpoints, tokens/sec went 1200 -> 1150 for model-x q4. CLI output:
```
throughput: 1150 tokens/s
p50 latency: 24ms
p95 latency: 98ms
```
I think it's due to warmup policy.

maria (growth): FYI I synced with sales — they'd like the launch to call out dedicated vs hosted cost tradeoffs. Emma, can we add a CTAs section? No blocker on timing.

noah (design): Uploaded updated hero image variants and OG. prefer variant B for scale. @emma ping me if cropping needed. :art: 

olivia (pm): Heads up — marketing calendar shows a product update on Thu; can we avoid overlapping publishes? @maria @emma

emma (content): @liam sending sequence length now — 1024 default. Thanks for the log. @olivia noted; I'll move scheduled publish to Fri 08:00 PT unless there are objections. @noah I'll pick variant B. :+1: 

liam (benchmarks): Quick note — I'll post a small table with before/after numbers in ~25m. No deeper blocker.

deploy-bot: Scheduled social post job for 2026-03-20 16:00 UTC created by maria.

maria (growth): tiny ask — can someone review PR #482? https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketing/pull/482 — just copy edits and CTA tweak. @emma @noah

emma (content): Reviewing now. If I don't finish in 30m, leave a comment and I'll pick up after lunch. Blocker: need to confirm the dedicated pricing blurb with finance — @finance (not in channel) can someone ping Ben?

noah (design): Reviewed PR, left one note about button color. All good otherwise.

olivia (pm): I'll coordinate with Ben. Also, quick sync: please add any required launch checklist items to the shared doc: https://docs.google.com/launch-checklist

emma (content): Done — added 'benchnotes summary' and 'pricing confirmation'. Thanks team. I think we can ship Friday if numbers look stable. :rocket:
